title: I'm Hungry: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Mia is hungry in the morning.
For breakfast, Mia has rice and fish.
At the end, Mia's tummy is full.
What does Mia have for breakfast?
What fruit does Mom give Mia?
What does Mom say at the end?

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Mia is hungry, and breakfast is ready. She has toast, eggs, milk and a banana. Now her tummy is full, and she says thank you to Mom.

items.q: How does Mia feel after breakfast?
items.model: She is not hungry now. Her tummy is full.

items.q: What does Mia say to Mom at the end?
What do you have for breakfast?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Mia says thank you for breakfast
